people.line: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan

people.name: Joktan
people.line: Son of Eber and ancestor of Arabian tribes

people.name: Peleg
people.line: Descendant of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
translations.bsb: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
translations.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
translations.asv: And unto Eber were born two sons: The name of the one was Peleg. For in his days was the earth divided. And his brother's name was Joktan.
